title: 10 Levels of Claude Code Mastery
blurb: From "terminal tourist" to "swarm architect." The gap between levels isn't knowledge — it's setup.
body:
Ten levels of Claude Code mastery, mapped from hundreds of real community setups — from "terminal tourist" to "swarm architect."

  • L0 — type prompts and hope for the best
  • L1 — a CLAUDE.md file; you know /compact and /cost
  • L2 — connected MCP servers (Slack, Notion, Drive) pulling live data
  • L3 — custom skills; repeatable workflows, one command
  • L4 — memory files, patterns, examples; context engineering
  • L5 — multi-phase skills, subagents, systems that chain together
  • L6 — headless mode; scripts calling Claude Code, JSON piping
  • L7 — Playwright browser control; screenshots, scraping, PDF generation
  • L8 — parallel sessions; orchestrator + specialist agents
  • L9 — cron jobs; background agents running 24/7 as infrastructure
  • L10 — autonomous loops; agents that build agents (a handful of people on the planet)

The gap between each level isn't knowledge — it's mostly just setup.

SOURCE · community "10 levels" post + /level-up tool.
